title: The Day the Puddles Learned to Fly
description: After the spring storm, the neighbors bring their brooms to the steps. The first puddle lifts on the wind, carrying an upside-down village with it.
alt: A translucent ribbon of water rises from a puddle on stone steps and reflects a cliffside village upside down as neighbors look up.
pairing: An imagined spring cleanup holiday × puddles that lift into the sky
